Real photographic skin on her face, neck, arms, hands, stomach, thighs and legs, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, very fine pale hair on her forearms catching the light and faint freckles on her chest V and the backs of her hands. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at knee height, the famous foreground landmark large at the bottom centre of the frame and she standing just behind it, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the real people, vehicles and trees around her ankles shown at their true size so her colossal height and the extreme heel height read at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor.
